titleZh: 哥本哈根倦怠量表（CBI，中文工作稿）

items.originalEnglish: How often do you feel tired?
How often are you physically exhausted?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会感到身体精疲力竭？

items.originalEnglish: How often are you emotionally exhausted?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会感到情绪上精疲力竭？

items.originalEnglish: How often do you think: “I can’t take it anymore”?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会觉得：“我再也撑不下去了”？

items.originalEnglish: How often do you feel worn out?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会感到筋疲力尽？

items.originalEnglish: How often do you feel weak and susceptible to illness?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会感到虚弱、容易生病？
你的工作在多大程度上让你情绪耗竭？

items.originalEnglish: Do you feel burnt out because of your work?
items.workingChinese: 你在多大程度上因工作而感到身心耗竭？
你的工作在多大程度上让你感到挫败？

items.originalEnglish: Do you feel worn out at the end of the working day?
items.workingChinese: 一天工作结束时，你多久会感到筋疲力尽？

items.originalEnglish: Are you exhausted in the morning at the thought of another day at work?
items.workingChinese: 早上想到又要工作一天时，你多久会感到精疲力竭？

items.originalEnglish: Do you feel that every working hour is tiring for you?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会觉得工作中的每一个小时都很累？

items.originalEnglish: Do you have enough energy for family and friends during leisure time?
items.workingChinese: 在闲暇时间，你多久有足够的精力陪伴家人和朋友？

items.originalEnglish: Do you find it hard to work with clients?
items.workingChinese: 你在多大程度上觉得与服务对象一起工作很困难？

items.originalEnglish: Do you find it frustrating to work with clients?
items.workingChinese: 你在多大程度上觉得与服务对象一起工作令人挫败？

items.originalEnglish: Does it drain your energy to work with clients?
items.workingChinese: 与服务对象一起工作在多大程度上消耗你的精力？

items.originalEnglish: Do you feel that you give more than you get back when you work with clients?
items.workingChinese: 与服务对象一起工作时，你在多大程度上觉得自己的付出多于得到的回报？

items.originalEnglish: Are you tired of working with clients?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会对与服务对象一起工作感到厌倦？

items.originalEnglish: Do you sometimes wonder how long you will be able to continue working with clients?
items.workingChinese: 你多久会想，自己还能继续与服务对象一起工作多长时间？

scores.label: Personal Burnout
scores.description: Mean of six personal burnout items scored 0–100; calculable when at least three items are answered.

scores.label: Work-related Burnout
scores.description: Mean of seven work-related burnout items scored 0–100; final energy item reverse-scored; calculable when at least four items are answered.

scores.label: Client-related Burnout
scores.description: Mean of six client-related burnout items scored 0–100; calculable when at least three items are answered.

existingEvidenceForVerification.population: Adult employees in the Danish PUMA study and related occupational samples
existingEvidenceForVerification.studyDesign: Development and psychometric evaluation of personal, work-related, and client-related burnout scales.
existingEvidenceForVerification.citation: Kristensen TS, Borritz M, Villadsen E, Christensen KB. (2005). The Copenhagen Burnout Inventory: A new tool for the assessment of burnout. Work & Stress, 19(3), 192–207.

existingEvidenceForVerification.studyDesign: Teacher-group validation using CFA, internal consistency and concurrent associations with work engagement and self-efficacy.
existingEvidenceForVerification.citation: Fiorilli C, De Stasio S, Benevene P, et al. (2015). Copenhagen Burnout Inventory (CBI): A validation study in an Italian teacher group.
existingEvidenceForVerification.notes: The teacher validation treated the client-related factor as student-related burnout.

existingEvidenceForVerification.studyDesign: Chinese CBI psychometric evaluation with CFA, internal consistency, test-retest and concurrent validity; follow-up n=245.
existingEvidenceForVerification.citation: Fong TCT, Ho RTH, Ng SM. (2014). Psychometric Properties of the Copenhagen Burnout Inventory—Chinese Version. The Journal of Psychology, 148(3), 255–266.
existingEvidenceForVerification.notes: This record does not authorize or freeze any zh-CN/zh-HK item wording in the present English executable.

reportGeneral.title: 给自己的工作状态留一点观察空间
reportGeneral.limitation: 这是一份待人工审校的中文工作稿，不是临床诊断，不评价教师能力，不用于绩效问责、录用或学校排名。结果反映这次自述体验；中文分数不能自动与国外样本比较。
reportGeneral.invalid: 这部分回答不足，暂时不能形成可靠结果。你可以补充作答，也可以保留空白；缺失不等于没有困难。
reportGeneral.reading: 这三个方面像三扇观察窗，分开看更有帮助；不是三项考试，也不合成一张总成绩单。不要用轻中重标签定义自己。

administration.instructionsZh: 请结合自己的实际感受作答。前两部分关注整体疲惫和工作相关疲惫；第三部分关注与服务对象互动带来的疲惫。在学校情境中，服务对象可以指学生。各部分的选项不同，请留意选项文字。
administration.timeframe: Original does not specify a fixed lookback; do not invent past2weeks/month.
administration.layout: Official recommends interspersing with unrelated questionnaire items to reduce stereotyped responses. Standalone grouped digital layout is a declared presentation change, not identical PUMA administration.

scoringNotes.scores: 3 independent dimension means0–100; no global19item total
scoringNotes.missing: Average only answered items if minimum met. Otherwise dimension invalid, not zero. Do not require all19 in a way that negates original partial-response rules.

references.population: Representative Danish adults20–59, N1498 valid, telephone interviews75% response
PUMA1917 human-service employees83%women; score valid Ns differ

externalReferenceDossier.thresholdNote: Original2004 p8 defines high degree descriptively as >=50 for PUMA prevalence22.2%personal/19.8%work/15.9%client. This is not diagnostic calibration, not a Chinese teacher cutoff. No75 severe threshold. No automatic bands or zscore/percentiles.

personal_burnout.title: 整体的身体与情绪疲惫
personal_burnout.meaning: 关注的不只是上班累不累，也包括整体的身体和情绪疲惫。它不会告诉你疲惫一定来自哪里。
personal_burnout.reflection: 最近哪些时段最容易没电？休息后是否稍有恢复？
personal_burnout.action: 选一个最容易坚持的恢复时段，先保护十分钟；若疲惫持续或影响生活，可寻求专业评估。

work_related_burnout.title: 工作带来的消耗
work_related_burnout.meaning: 看看工作是否正在挤占恢复空间。感到耗竭不等于你不够努力，也不等于教学能力差。
work_related_burnout.reflection: 最消耗你的，是任务量、节奏，还是总要保持在线？
work_related_burnout.action: 记录一项最消耗精力的工作，与可信同事或负责人商量减量、调整优先级或增加支持。

client_related_burnout.title: 与服务对象互动时的消耗
client_related_burnout.meaning: 长期面对他人的需求也会消耗精力。这描述互动体验，不是在评价学生或责怪任何人。
client_related_burnout.reflection: 哪些互动后你最需要缓一缓？什么支持能让你更好地恢复？
client_related_burnout.action: 尝试在高负荷互动后留一个短暂停顿，并讨论可获得的同伴支持与合理边界。

reportPresentationDesignGoal: 希望将数字降级为方法详情，但本任务未修改报告UI，不能声称该隐藏已实现。
